_doc: Site 1 item 25, stretch 2, survey row (no data): a private pier below the Bay View, in no chart, OSM or footprint data, found only in the lidar (ME_MidCoast 2021, tide -1.34). Level metres. 24.5 m x 2 m: 8 m falling at 1:4 from the bank (+6.1 to +4.1; a stair or cleated ramp, ASSUMED cleated ramp), then 16.5 m level at +4.1, rails +5.1; at the outer end something 3 m wide reaches +6.5 (a gallows for the gangway, ASSUMED: hoist); a gangway of about 15 m to a float, deck -0.8 at that tide (freeboard 0.55), about 5 m across the gangway's foot; its length along the shore is not in the returns (3 x 6 ASSUMED). All of it waits on photo V2.1.
